description: This file defines API handlers for compliance-related endpoints in a Mattermost/Focalboard server, including routes for fetching boards and block histories with pagination and filtering, enforcing permissions and license checks.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API handler class for compliance-related endpoints, encapsulating permissions, app context, and logger.

methods.name: registerComplianceRoutes
methods.description: Registers compliance API routes to the provided mux router.

methods.name: handleGetBoardsForCompliance
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve boards for compliance, with pagination and team filtering.

methods.name: handleGetBoardsComplianceHistory
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve compliance history of boards, with filtering by modification time, team, and pagination.

methods.name: handleGetBlocksComplianceHistory
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve block histories for compliance, with filtering by modification time, team, board, and pagination.
